decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on the firm's established pharmacy offer and has its own web page, which suggests results meet aspirations, and the expanding firm has the slack to carry it.
The skin and hair supplement was actively launched through pharmacies with its own page and fits the firm's consumer health expansion strategy, so there is no shortfall to trigger search.
The joint supplement extends the established Trivital brand at low cost, and the growing firm can carry it while its results remain uncertain.
The mushroom-based immune supplement gets less prominence and is a niche product, but it is cheap to maintain within the existing supplement line, and slack lets the firm keep it.

The generic valsartan is distant from the firm's core offer and was hit by the 2018 valsartan contamination recall, a clear shortfall that prompts problemistic search and redeployment of its resources.
